# Tax Stamps
DTS in full is Digital Tracking Solution. URA in partnership with Uganda National Bureau of Standards (UNBS) introduced the Digital Tracking Solution (DTS) as a track & trace platform that sends production and importation data for specific products immediately, to both URA and UNBS. It is being used in Rwanda, Tanzania and Kenya among other countries.
